method: paired six-seed differences on deterministic synthetic scenarios; two-sided one-sample t interval/test on per-seed accuracy differences; exploratory due n=6
difference_definition: CMX accuracy minus newest-valid baseline accuracy; for ablations, ablation accuracy minus full CMX accuracy
interpretation: The clean/low-noise superiority of newest-valid is robust in this proxy.
The 15% CMX crossover is exploratory and not statistically resolved at six seeds.
The defining coupon/rent components fail the predeclared positive-ablation criterion; the data do not establish that either component is beneficial.
Adaptive budget is the only clearly supported component in this matrix, but it is a conventional cost-sensitive retrieval optimization and not unique evidence for CMX.
